fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $49,500 for the Core or Plus Program. Honorably discharged veterans and/or educators receive a $4,950 reduction, bringing the fee to $44,550. The fee is paid at signing of the Franchise Agreement and is fully earned and non-refundable upon receipt. Additional required costs include: a Starter Kit ($2,300–$4,000), an Enhanced Business Coaching and Training Fee ($5,750 for first-location purchasers), and optional Plus Program training fees ($5,000 for one additional program or $15,000 for all three: travel soccer, Spirit League, and Shining Soccer Stars).
raw_excerpt: Your initial franchise fee will be $49,500 for a Franchised Business offering the Core or the Plus Program. If you are an honorably discharged veteran and/or educator, we will reduce the initial franchise fee by $4,950 for the Core Program.
